name: Airtable
description: A spreadsheet-database hybrid platform offering a flexible REST API and Model Context Protocol (MCP) server for managing bases, tables, records, and workflows.

evidence.claim: Airtable combines the simplicity of a spreadsheet with the power of a database, offering a flexible REST API for programmatic access to bases, tables, records, and attachments.
Any MCP-compatible tool can read, write, and query your bases through natural language, scoped to your existing permissions.
Authentication methods include personal access tokens and OAuth integration.

notes: Airtable provides both a comprehensive REST API and an official MCP server with robust agent skills.
